name: bhdc_small_proof
note: Small CPU-runnable proof that the fused-model pipeline learns end-to-end (capability + conscience + coupling). Not a scale result; validates the machinery.

preregistration.prediction: A small fused model trained briefly on CPU will (a) reduce val bits-per-byte below the 8.0 random baseline, (b) develop a positive harm and sycophancy separation on the moral val set, and (c) show harmful-field mean coupling gain < benign-field mean gain. This validates the pipeline; it is not a capability claim.
preregistration.kill_condition: Pipeline is broken if capability does not improve, the conscience shows no separation, or the coupling has no differential effect.
